verdict.rationale: Customer.io publishes an official Postman collection for getting started with its APIs, which gives runnable request examples. It also serves a primary OpenAPI spec (confirmed live by probe) covering the Track, App, and Design Studio APIs. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive in-browser API reference with try-it/runnable examples on the docs site itself; runnability depends on importing into Postman. Missing for 10: documented interactive in-docs API reference (try-it console), runnable examples embedded in the reference pages, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: We've generated a Postman collection to help you get started with our APIs.
Primary OpenAPI spec for the Track (ingress), App, and Design Studio APIs together, at the conventional path
